translation: From then on, every dog day I must sun myself, and all the accumulation diseases were no longer a harm, and the dampness and drawing and pulling stopped abruptly. I have not begged for numina from plants and trees for nearly twenty years; now, regardless of winter or summer, on clear days I must sun myself, and occasionally there is slight sweat, because there is no disease. The power and merit of sunning can be said to be great: it strengthens the primordial yang of the prenatal, nourishes the true yin of the postnatal, the spirit light penetrates and is clear, the exterior and interior are not left out, the yin nebula secretly disperses, and the constructive and defensive have no gap. Even if there is great accumulation throughout the body, it can make it lie hidden and not be a harm; if qi and blood were not sufficient, could it be like this? When the accumulation lies hidden, the blood is sufficient to nourish it; and when the accumulation comes out, the qi is sufficient to move it; removing the evil and supporting the upright, can one say it is even more spirit-like? Now I see the maxim of the Perfected Sun, and awakened, I practice it, as if ghosts and spirits penetrate it. So I dispersed the accumulation of more than sixty years completely within a month, and swept clear all the internal and external diseases; this is precisely relying on the sufficiency of qi and blood. Without several years of sunning merit, could it be this fast? This is what is called Heaven blessing it, auspicious and without disadvantage.
